thesis: Contractual exit is necessary but insufficient when responsibility is detached from authority and resources.

ideas.statement: Workers need usable exit, protected voice and enforceable safeguards; managers must own tradeoffs and roles must not absorb the person’s whole life.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Interdependence is not automatically domination; employers’ initiative and regulatory costs matter, representatives need accountability, and pressure does not excuse every negligence.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Interdependence is not automatically domination; employers’ initiative and regulatory costs matter, representatives need accountability, and pressure does not excuse every negligence.
